_comment: GENERATED by `python3 -m edge_workbench.prepare`. Do not edit:
re-run it. This is what the build reads instead of the
tutorial, so that a build depends on files in this repository
and not on which branch a sibling checkout happens to be on.
`source.sha` is the commit the tutorial was read at. A gate
compares it against the tutorial's head to tell you when the
tutorial has moved and this needs re-running.
`gaps` lists what the tutorial does not state in a form this
step can read. Those are the model-assisted half's input; an
empty list means the tutorial said everything itself.

example.quote: Consider the five-vertex graph with directed edges

meanings.init: The frontier starts with only the source, and the source is recorded as its own parent.

tensorNotes.G: The graph: true where edge s to d exists.
tensorNotes.F: The frontier: the vertices being expanded at this level.
tensorNotes.Tree: The BFS tree: true where s is recorded as the parent of d.
tensorNotes.Visited: Vertices with a parent recorded in the tree.
tensorNotes.NV: Not Visited: vertices with no parent recorded yet.
tensorNotes.NeiNV: Neighbors of the frontier that are Not Visited, the new discoveries.
tensorNotes.CandTree: Candidate parent-child edges for the new discoveries.
tensorNotes.Temp: The one parent selected for each new child.

quotes.init: The frontier contains only the source, and the source is its own parent

E01.graph: From all vertices in the frontier, collect all outgoing neighbors.
E01.einsum: Elementwise AND between $G_{s,d}$ and $F_{i,s}$ produces a tensor that identifies all candidate edges $(s,d)$ from the current frontier. Reducing over $s$ using OR then determines whether each vertex $d$ has at least one such incoming edge, thereby gathering all neighbors of the frontier.

E02.graph: Find every vertex that already has a parent in the BFS tree.
E02.einsum: Reduce the Boolean tensor $\mathit{Tree}$ over index $p$ using OR.

E03.graph: Find every vertex that does not yet have a parent in the BFS tree.

E04.graph: Keep only neighbors that have not been discovered before.

E05.graph: Record all parents for newly discovered vertices from the frontier.
E05.einsum: Compute $(G_{s,d} \cdot F_{i,s})$ and broadcast it into the $(i,s,d)$ space, then AND with $\mathit{NeiNV}_{i,d}$.

E06.graph: If multiple frontier vertices discover the same child, keep the first one found as the parent.
E06.einsum: Populate a new tensor by applying a coordinate operator `pick-parent` to choose one $s$ per $d$.

E07.graph: Add the newly discovered parent-child edges into the BFS tree.
E07.einsum: Elementwise OR between the previous tree and the new assignments.

E08.graph: Set the next frontier to all newly discovered vertices.

stop.graph: Stop when there are no newly discovered vertices.
stop.einsum: Check whether any entry in $F_{i+1}$ is True.
